videos.description: • A product overview video showcasing a tabletop waterfall fountain displayed on a marble side table next to a leather sofa, filmed from multiple angles as the camera slowly rotates around the piece. • The fountain features a multi-tiered rock formation design with cascading water, a color-changing LED light ball nestled among the rocks, and decorative river pebbles arranged around the base in a rectangular black tray. • The video also shows the fountain paired alongside a separate potted green plant, illustrating how the piece fits into an indoor living space as a decorative accent.
